general.description: This large telluric planet has quite a strong gravity, thus rendering it less hospitable than it normally should. The rights on the planet was sold to the Irmothem by the Arythem, to allo the former to establish an outpost. However, most of the installations are in high atmosphere or hung to the orbital elevator's tether.
general.bar: Many Rithai discussing trade, mostly Arythem and Irmothem, among them a few local cloud pilots
